title: Traditional Song of the Highlands No. 77 (Rwai Lum bad Wah Vol. 11)
khasi_title: Rwai Lum bad Wah Ba-paka No. 77
cultural_context: Laments tragic legends and honors sacred rivers, peaks, and monoliths. Passed down orally through generations of Khasi and Pnar families across Meghalaya.
lyrics_khasi:
Mynsiem bakhuid ko Blei U Kynrad,
Me la thaw ia ka bneng bad pyrthei;
Ha Lum Sohpetbneng la kiew la hiar,
Ka jingkieng ksier ba donburom.
lyrics_english:
Holy Spirit, O Sovereign Creator,
Thou hast formed the heavens and the earth;
Upon the sacred mount of Sohpetbneng,
The golden ladder of innocence linked earth with heaven.
